logline: A superpowered but spiritually depleted family meets a calculated con artist who can either restore their fading abilities or unravel the last bonds holding them together.

renewal.note: Twelve-episode limited series that completed its JTBC run on June 9, 2024. No second season announced.

bollymeter.basis: Ranked 5th on NME's 2024 year-end K-drama list and in TIME's top 10 for 2024; writer Joo Hwa-mi won Best Writer at the 2024 Asia Contents Awards; IMDb 7.6 and a JTBC finale rating of 4.858 percent confirm solid but not exceptional reach.

seasons.review_body: Airing on JTBC from May 4 to June 9, 2024 with Netflix international distribution, The Atypical Family married a fading-superpowers family premise with a romantic con-artist infiltration plot. Jang Ki-yong plays a man who can travel into his own happy memories but has exhausted them, while Chun Woo-hee is the outsider who threatens and renews the family. NME placed it fifth on their 2024 K-drama year-end list and TIME included it in their top ten; screenwriter Joo Hwa-mi won the Best Writer award at the 2024 Asia Contents Awards and Global OTT Awards. The JTBC finale landed 4.858 percent nationwide.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.review_body: The Atypical Family Season 1 Episode 1 aired May 4, 2024 on JTBC as the premiere of the twelve-episode limited series. IMDb audiences scored the series 7.6. The Asia Contents Awards 2024 awarded Best Writer to screenwriter Joo Hwa-mi; NME placed the series fifth on its 2024 K-drama year-end list. The premiere introduces the Bok family's supernatural inheritance with tonal efficiency: each member carries a different power - time-travel via happy memories, flight, precognitive dreams - and the episode establishes immediately that all three are fading. The central dramatic engine is legible from the first act: a family whose gifts are running dry meets an outsider who may restore or destroy them. Chun Woo-hee's introduction as Do Da-hae, the con artist, is the episode's tonal pivot - she arrives as threat, complication, and possible salvation simultaneously.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere establishes the Bok family's supernatural inventory with playful economy - time-travel via memories, flight, precognitive dreams - and immediately signals that all three powers are fading. Do Da-hae's introduction as the con artist is the tonal hook the episode lands on.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Bok Gwi-ju discovering his memory-travel ability is drying up - the show's central tragedy given to the audience before the romance even begins.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 12
episode_reviews.review_body: The Atypical Family Season 1 Episode 12 aired June 9, 2024 on JTBC as the series finale. The episode recorded a 4.858 percent nationwide rating, consistent with the series' loyal audience across its run. IMDb scored the series 7.6. Screenwriter Joo Hwa-mi won Best Writer at the 2024 Asia Contents Awards and Global OTT Awards. The finale resolves the family's supernatural crisis and the romantic complication with the economy the series established in its premiere. TIME included the series in its 2024 top ten. The finale delivers the warmth the show consistently earned across twelve episodes - a genre conclusion that treats its fantasy mechanics as a vehicle for emotional truth rather than spectacle.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The 4.858 percent domestic finale rating reflects a series that built a loyal audience through consistent warmth rather than escalating twists.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The family's powers restored in the context of real emotional stakes - the show keeping its fantasy mechanics earned.
